minor.issue: Daily/Monthly reports show 0 bills when no bills are due in that period - this is expected behavior but may confuse users. Consider adding a note or showing all pending bills option.

issues: Daily report shows 0 bills because no bills due today - expected behavior but could be clearer to users

Accurassi API integration properly falls back to OCR when credentials not configured
Admin bulk payment report date filtering working correctly - normalizes date comparison
All DDR and Provider Connection endpoints working with proper authentication
